Derivatives of the developmental system at a steady state

Source: R/develop.R
sensitivity.Rd

Derivatives of the developmental system at a steady state

Usage

sensitivity(model, genotype, x = NULL)

Arguments

model

A `grn` model.

genotype

Vector of genotypic values.

x

Steady-state expression of all genes. Computed if omitted.

Value

A list with `x`, the Jacobian `J` (\(\partial f/\partial x\)), `dfdp` (\(\partial f/\partial\) loci) and the sensitivity matrix `S` \(= \partial x^*/\partial\) loci \(= -J^{-1} \partial f/\partial p\) (all genes by all loci).
